description: Extract every {{variable}}-style placeholder from a prompt template, reporting each unique variable's occurrence count and flagging ones used more than once. Optionally cross-check against a providedVars list to flag variables the template uses that are missing, and provided names the template never references.

providedVars.description: Optional list of variable names already available, to cross-check against the template

template.description: The prompt template text containing {{variable}} placeholders

name: extract_prompt_template_variables
